limitations: 442/442 original lessons and 15/15 expansion lessons are editorially accepted. All 84 supporting items are reviewed separately; learner study status is independent.
Windows Server role-level procedures were not executed; Batch 02 provides an explicit tabletop lab.
Physical network failures remain synthetic. Isolated Linux LAN, VLAN and routing labs validate virtual behavior only; physical hardware, external routing and throughput are untested.
Batch 05 DNS, DHCP, NAT and STP explorers are bounded teaching models, not live service or convergence tests. The dual-stack lab uses static routes, not SLAAC/RA/DHCPv6 service validation.
Current certification alignment is not claimed.

Batch 07 accepted within documented guided/model/tabletop/local-Linux scopes. Actual Cisco parser, DTP/VTP, physical phone/QoS, aggregation, boot/install/restoration and vendor commands remain unexecuted.
Batch10 accepted within declared browser, ideal calculation and guided lab scopes. Actual target-router configuration, traffic and convergence remain unexecuted.
Network Services Batches11/12 accepted within scoped synthetic/guided/loopback evidence. NTP, SNMP, AAA and vendor monitoring-platform target procedures remain unexecuted.

Cisco Data Center Batches17/18 accepted within declared model, guided and offline-plan scopes. Cisco/APIC target execution, actual forwarding/convergence, firewall HA, storage I/O and measured throughput remain unverified.

Storage & Virtualization Batches 19–21 accepted within authored/model/guided/offline scopes. Real FC/iSCSI/NFS/SMB service changes, hypervisor migration/HA, Docker and Kubernetes execution remain unverified; actual new runtime evidence is owned-file corruption/restore and cleanup.

Automation & Infrastructure Architecture Batches 22-24 accepted within authored/model/guided/local-file scopes. External API and device operations, library/provider deployments, enterprise HA and recovery timing remain unexecuted. Local Python examples and validation/render/change/rollback evidence are independently scoped.
Physical Hardware accepted within reused foundation-model, authored incident, guided tabletop and local read-only scopes; physical/vendor operations remain unexecuted.

Cisco Device Mastery Batch 25 is accepted as authored teaching, interactive worksheets and guided labs. Cisco target commands, configuration, traffic, power, RF, failover and SAN I/O remain unexecuted; the local Python lab only computes declared evidence gates.

Batches 29–33 add actual owned-file, ordinary-user Linux, loopback HTTP/TLS and restricted cached-image container evidence. Nginx/ACME, LVM mutation, systemd unit/timer deployment, Kubernetes operations and cloud provisioning remain guided/unexecuted. Cloud prices and capacity are supplied fictional models.
Browser checks cover local Edge, keyboard controls, reduced motion and four widths in both themes; they do not constitute a complete assistive-technology or external WCAG audit.
